description: Symbolic Markov trace of σ_1σ_2σ_1 (the H_3 longest element w_0, used as a proton-equivalent demo word) via direct Markov-axiom reduction in ℚ(q). Gives the categorically-clean closed form tr_M(σ_1σ_2σ_1)(q) = z(1 + hz) where z = 1/(q^{1/2}+q^{-1/2}) and h = q-q^{-1}. Bypasses PR #546's IndexError on σ_2; uses pure Markov axioms + Hecke quadratic + cyclicity, no rep theory. Demonstrates that the canonical Markov-trace closed form is FULLY SYMMETRIC under q ↔ 1/q (in contrast to the Plancherel-trace form's anti-self-reciprocity).
